scope: Targeted primary-source review and repository audit; not an exhaustive systematic review or external implementation audit. PDF page indices refer to file pages. Acquisition timestamps may be November 9 UTC while the review date remains November 8 locally.
copyright: Only original analysis and metadata are published. Downloaded PDFs, full extracted text, and inspection images are private working material.

sources.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights
sources.reviewed_sections: What Comes Next?; access protocols and released-source boundaries through the repository source review
sources.finding: The report motivates direct reading, writing, auditing, creation, cost reduction, unlearning, recursive improvement, and circuit grafting.
sources.limitation: Selected demonstrations and author hypotheses do not establish population-level reliability, causal interpretability, universal preservation, or efficiency at matched outcomes.
sources.framework_implication: Use its future directions as hypotheses with separate access, intervention, retention, and cost tests; preserve source reproduction tiers.

sources.title: AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models
sources.reviewed_sections: Nullspace projection, sequential-edit objective, eigenvalue cutoff, limitations
sources.finding: Projecting an update against retained linear keys reduces interference under the specified representation. The practical method uses an eigenvalue threshold of 1e-2.
sources.limitation: A numerical near-nullspace over sampled keys is not exact preservation of every input or every downstream decision. Transfer to reasoning and multimodal models remains outside its experiments.
sources.framework_implication: Measure rank, conditioning, threshold sensitivity, exact endpoint residuals, and held-out behavior instead of calling a tolerance pass an exact guarantee.

sources.title: Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT
sources.finding: Localization is tested through interventions and subsequent factual edits, providing a model for testing a diagnosis rather than accepting a plausible explanation.
sources.limitation: Evidence for a particular factual-association setting does not establish a universal causal circuit or cross-architecture transfer.
sources.framework_implication: Freeze predicted repair locations and effects, then compare with sham, random, and matched interventions on independent cases.

sources.title: Mass-Editing Memory in a Transformer
sources.reviewed_sections: Batch editing method and evaluation setting
sources.finding: Multiple factual associations can be edited jointly in the studied transformer models.
sources.limitation: Batch insertion performance is different from preservation across a long adaptive sequence; knowledge editing is different from enterprise queue routing.
sources.framework_implication: Use as a relevant editing control where architecture/task fit; retain all previously inserted targets in sequential evaluation.

sources.title: The Mirage of Model Editing: Revisiting Evaluation in the Wild
sources.finding: Teacher forcing, target-length truncation, context-free prompts, and permissive matching can inflate reported editing success; natural decoding exposes failures.
sources.limitation: The study examines representative methods and models; its findings do not establish universal failure of every future editor.
sources.framework_implication: For generated-output tasks freeze autoregressive decoding, natural termination, prompt/context variation, and explicit scoring. For routing, evaluate complete predictions on independent text.

sources.title: Benchmarking and Rethinking Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models
sources.reviewed_sections: Task/access comparison and contextual reasoning alternative
sources.finding: Evaluation spans fact, event, and more general tasks, with reliability, generalization, locality, and portability; a contextual reasoning baseline tests whether weight changes are needed.
sources.limitation: Reported comparisons depend on task, prompt, compute, and model choices; a context baseline is not proven best for every application.
sources.framework_implication: Compare weight edits with rules, a routing overlay, and context/retrieval methods when task-compatible, using the same allowed evidence and full costs.

sources.title: ForgetBench: Benchmarking Forgetting Dynamics of Long-Term Parametric Memory in Language Models
sources.finding: An accuracy matrix indexed by edit time and memory age separates insertion success from later decay and variability.
sources.limitation: Synthetic and semi-synthetic knowledge-edit streams do not establish production retention or arbitrary continual learning performance.
sources.framework_implication: Evaluate whole edit lineages, original-baseline retention, old targets, conflicts, and task order; report retention curves with sequence-level uncertainty.

sources.title: Measure, Don’t Optimize: Forecasting Recovery in LLM Unlearning
sources.reviewed_sections: Recovery forecasting rationale and audit/optimization distinction
sources.finding: Internal accessibility measurements can predict recovery in the studied settings; optimizing an audit signal can obscure the robustness it was intended to measure.
sources.limitation: A scoped empirical audit is not a universal test of information erasure or an implementation we have reproduced.
sources.framework_implication: Keep blinded recovery tests independent of the edit objective and disclose exactly which recovery attacks and budgets were evaluated.

sources.title: MUSE: Machine Unlearning Six-Way Evaluation for Language Models
sources.finding: Verbatim memorization, knowledge memorization, privacy leakage, utility, scalability, and repeated requests are separate unlearning outcomes.
sources.limitation: Passing one endpoint or benchmark is insufficient for general erasure or privacy guarantees.
sources.framework_implication: Use distinct forget/retain/extraction/privacy/cost/repetition endpoints and a retain-only reference in a gated synthetic unlearning study.

sources.title: TOFU: A Task of Fictitious Unlearning for LLMs
sources.reviewed_sections: Synthetic identities, retain-only reference, truth-ratio evaluation
sources.finding: Fictitious data permits a controlled reference trained without forget examples and distributional comparison of forgetting behavior.
sources.limitation: Synthetic author identities and benchmark behavior do not demonstrate deletion of real confidential data from arbitrary pretrained models.
sources.framework_implication: Begin with synthetic forget data; distinguish refusal or suppression from residual accessibility and preserve retain utility.

sources.title: Catastrophic Failure of LLM Unlearning via Quantization
sources.finding: Deployment quantization can recover knowledge suppressed by the evaluated unlearning methods.
sources.limitation: The result is scoped to studied models, methods, and transforms; it is not a universal mathematical impossibility result.
sources.framework_implication: Evaluate forgetting after deployed numerical transforms and bounded recovery attempts; do not infer erasure from the original full-precision output.

sources.title: TorchLean: Formalizing Neural Networks in Lean
sources.reviewed_sections: Shared graph semantics; Table 3 scope; finite Float32 refinement and external boundaries
sources.finding: Shared SSA/DAG semantics connect execution and analysis. The scope table distinguishes proved, checked, and external components; finite-path IEEE32Exec refinement is explicitly restricted.
sources.limitation: The paper does not discharge the target CPU/CUDA kernel and hardware link universally. Repository code was not built or audited in this review.
sources.framework_implication: Evaluate reuse of explicit semantic/proof subsets; keep serializer, compiler, backend, nonfinite values, and unsupported operators visible in the trust boundary.

sources.title: Efficient Neural Network Robustness Certification with General Activation Functions
sources.finding: Activation envelopes yield conservative bounds for a specified input domain and supported network.
sources.limitation: Loose bounds can reject safe candidates; absence of a passing bound is different from an observed violation. The paper is not a proof of this repository runtime.
sources.framework_implication: Compare current sequential drift bounds with tighter validated relaxations using coverage, width, time, and memory under identical domains.

sources.title: Provable Repair of Deep Neural Networks
sources.reviewed_sections: Decoupled architecture and one-layer linear-program repair
sources.finding: Separating activation and value paths permits a one-layer repair problem to be expressed as an LP in the specified setting.
sources.limitation: This tractability does not extend automatically to arbitrary ordinary networks, unknown activation regions, or a general editor.
sources.framework_implication: Explore a narrowly supported repair adapter and benchmark certificate coverage before promising arbitrary nonlinear repair.

sources.title: Equivariant Deep Weight Space Alignment
sources.finding: Symmetry-aware alignment helps compare or merge compatible parameterizations.
sources.limitation: Alignment is not proof of a causally transferable circuit between unrelated architectures.
sources.framework_implication: Test known same-function permutations first, then independent trained lineages; compare raw, aligned, and matched controls before circuit-grafting claims.

sources.title: Scale Equivariant Graph Metanetworks
sources.finding: Weight processing can incorporate valid scaling and permutation symmetries for supported model families.
sources.limitation: Scaling symmetry depends on activation and graph structure; positive rescaling is not an unrestricted equivalence for tanh or arbitrary models.
sources.framework_implication: Declare symmetry groups per adapter and include function-preservation positive controls and unsupported-family rejection.

sources.title: Permutation Equivariant Neural Functionals
sources.finding: Permutation-equivariant processing provides a learned alternative to raw coordinate interpretation for weights and gradients.
sources.limitation: Success on the evaluated neural-functional tasks is not a general-purpose language model understanding arbitrary weights.
sources.framework_implication: Compare symmetry-aware summaries/learned readers with raw weights and context-only readers on held-out training lineages.

sources.title: Equivariant Architectures for Learning in Deep Weight Spaces
sources.finding: Architectures that respect MLP parameter symmetries support functions over a collection of trained networks.
sources.limitation: Architecture specificity, initialization, training difficulty, and implementation complexity constrain generalization.
sources.framework_implication: Hold out model lineages and architecture families; charge reader training and model-zoo construction in cost claims.

sources.title: Towards Scalable and Versatile Weight Space Learning
sources.finding: Subsequence processing and learned representations can make model-zoo weight analysis scalable.
sources.limitation: Compression, conditioning, data collection, reader training, and reconstruction create costs and information losses.
sources.framework_implication: Profile dense weight access first; evaluate summaries/chunks at matched downstream performance and include amortization assumptions.

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.finding: Low-rank fitting is an established adaptation route and a useful comparator when architecture and task permit.
sources.limitation: Low parameter count or rank does not establish retained behavior, cheap total workflow, or no-fitting construction.
sources.framework_implication: Include head retraining and appropriate low-rank/full-training controls with tuned development budgets and retention/cost measurements.

sources.title: An Evaluation Dataset for Intent Classification and Out-of-Scope Prediction
sources.reviewed_sections: Dataset task and out-of-scope evaluation; author repository README/LICENSE
sources.finding: A public English single-intent dataset includes explicit in-scope and out-of-scope queries for text routing experiments.
sources.limitation: Crowdsourced single-intent queries are not multi-intent tickets, live customer telemetry, or our existing outage policy.
sources.framework_implication: Use as a cross-dataset/OOD routing extension; freeze a derived queue mapping and retain its synthetic-policy provenance.

sources.title: Efficient Intent Detection with Dual Sentence Encoders
sources.reviewed_sections: Fine-grained banking intent task; author repository README/LICENSE
sources.finding: Public fine-grained banking service intents provide a tractable trained text-classification starting point.
sources.limitation: The dataset supplies intents, not enterprise operational queues or a telemetry-outage policy. Queue assignment is a task derived by this project.
sources.framework_implication: Train a real text head, derive and freeze an ownership-change policy, and compare with an overlay operating on the unchanged intent predictions.

sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
sources.finding: Abstention trades coverage for conditional prediction risk under the studied evaluation setting.
sources.limitation: Calibration and in-distribution bounds do not establish arbitrary OOD correctness, and low risk can conceal near-zero coverage.
sources.framework_implication: Report all-trial useful success, admission/coverage, conditional harm, and abstention reasons together; freeze thresholds on development data.
